 Fantasy Football Start’em, Sit’em Lineup Advice: Stefon Diggs, Makai Lemon, Antonio Williams 
 Here’s Derek Brown’s fantasy football Week 8 outlook for a few players to help with lineup decisions.
 Antonio Williams (WR – WAS) 
 Antonio Williams will see an elevated role in the Washington passing attack with Terry McLaurin out for the rest of the season. Since Week 4, Williams has had a 13.7% target share, 1.12 YPRR, two deep targets, and a 16.7% first-read share. Williams is a decent flex play this week. Over their last five games, Philly has allowed the 12th-most yards per target, the most receiving fantasy points per game, and the ninth-most fantasy points per opportunity to wide receivers. 
 Makai Lemon (WR – PHI) 
 Well, it happened. Makai Lemon had his best game of the season against a horrible Dallas secondary. Lemon was the WR13 for the week. Over the last two weeks, Lemon has had a 16.3% target share with 1.13 YPRR, one red zone target, and a 21.4% first-read share. Lemon offers some flex upside this week. Over their last five games, Washington has allowed the 13th-most fantasy points per opportunity to slot receivers while ranking 16th in yards per target allowed to the position. 
 Stefon Diggs (WR – WAS) 
 With Terry McLaurin out for the season, Stefon Diggs will be leading the way for Washington’s aerial attack moving forward. Diggs is the WR24 in fantasy points per game with a 20.9% target share, 1.60 YPRR, five red zone targets, four deep targets, and a 25.4% first-read share. Diggs should be a strong WR2 this week. Over their last five games, Philly has allowed the 13th-most yards per target, the most receiving fantasy points per game, and the seventh-most fantasy points per opportunity to slot receivers.
